newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gun-wielding motorist snapped by cool passenger.
newsitem.headline: Gun-wielding motorist snapped by cool passenger.

text.p: A motorist threatened a fellow driver with a starting pistol as he overtook him illegally in the inside lane on a motorway near Berlin and was photographed in the act by the driver's wife, prosecutors said on Wednesday.

Prosecutors in the city of Potsdam said the 32-year-old man drew alongside the other car at about 110 kph (70 mph) and aimed his pistol at the driver. But the driver's wife kept her nerve, got out her camera and photographed him.
The man has been charged with dangerous driving, coercion and threatening behaviour.
